test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

Only three people sit between W and Y. A sits to the immediate left of Y. No one sits to the right of B. Only two people sit between B and A. X sits to the immediate right of D.

How many people sit between C and X?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

1. No one sits to the right of B. 

2. Only two people sit between B and A. 

3. A sits to the immediate left of Y.

4. Only three people sit between W and Y.

5. X sits to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f24929f58d8895864daa11fa1c6648ae97d36b1761999bb3ef76eb9b053c4d9.png] 

C, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53cc74128c6144e19942a1ec8210a00e9bad433cc5fbc0bb827c17977f66226e.png] 

Thus, two people sit between C and X.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
